title: proof/snapshot 임시 배열의 할당·복사 축소
existingWork: bufferProofs, textureProofs, snapshotResources 및 groupResources 수집·복사는 남아 있음. 기존 std::move 변경은 완료 범위.
missingEvidence: 현재 slow/capture 경로의 반복 빈도와 비용 미확정.
requiredBoundary: 실제 유효 capture 이후 필요한 크기만 확보; hit/negative/failure/단일원소에서 새 할당을 늘리지 않음.

risk.function: 낮음~중간: 같은 순서/개수/weak proof를 보존하는 reserve만. proof→snapshot→group의 소유 목록을 합치면 별도 설계가 된다.
risk.lifetime: 현재 std::move는 완료 범위. weak proof를 strong/native owner로 바꾸거나 전역 scratch를 공유하면 안 된다.
risk.memory: 선예약은 실패가 늦게 나면 기존보다 큰 capacity를 잠깐 잡을 수 있다. 첫 유효 proof를 봤다는 것만으로 전체 capture 성공을 알 수 없다.

strategy: Reuse the exact bounded-positive-reserve patch and existing correctness qualification. Do not implement another vector/SBO/cache scheme.
acceptance: Finish the already prepared forward8/reverse8 comparison without original contaminated8 pooling
Keep R selected unless a later adoption decision names Small
tests: Existing Small descriptor/texture CPU, native and package receipts; do not repeat without cause
dependencyMeaning: Interactions require re-review; they are not permission to enable all related changes together.
designStage: Exact source capsules where named; broader missing-target/ownership/pass designs remain gated where stated
stopRule: Any unclosed correctness/lifetime counterexample, changed parent, failed check or unclear measurement stops this module. Preserve failure evidence; no automatic replay.
rollback: Prepared source module: exact reverse patch only against its postimage, refresh mtimes and rebuild all affected headers. No-code module: active product remains unchanged; no invented reverse patch.
